article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — TJ Power had 38 points and 12 rebounds to lead Pennsylvania past Dartmouth 80-71 on Friday night. Michael Zanoni scored 10 points, going 3 of 11 from the floor for the Quakers (14-11, 7-5 Ivy League). Brandon Mitchell-Day finished with 23 points and eight rebounds for the Big Green (11-14, 5-7). Dartmouth also got 18 points and two steals from Cameron McNamee. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
